title: Decrement machine on a non-underflowing word
statement: Let $k$ be a number of work tapes, choose one tape $i$, and let $x$ be an input word and $w,v$ Boolean words. Suppose fixed-width decrement sends $w$ to $v$, the initial configuration $d$ is in the run phase, and tape $i$ agrees with the buffer storing $w$ at every offset $p$ from its head position with $-1\le p\le |w|$. After $2|(w\text{ begins with false})|+2$ steps, the decrement machine is in the done phase with flag true; on tape $i$, the cells from the initial head position through the next $|w|-1$ cells contain the buffered word $v$, and all other tape contents are unchanged. It has not reached either done phase at any earlier time, and through that time tape $i$'s head stays between one cell left of its initial position and the initial position plus the number of leading false bits of $w$, inclusive; every other tape head remains fixed.
